Legal.cookieBanner: We use cookies required for sign-in, plus anonymous analytics if you consent
Legal.privacyP1: MeeChat stores account data (email, display name), personas, conversations, memories, energy ledger rows, and creator profiles to operate the service.
Legal.privacyP2: Chat content and memories are retained while your account exists. You can export a summary of your data or delete your account from Settings. Deletion removes app data cascaded from your user row and removes the auth user when possible.
Legal.privacyP3: We process data under Thailand PDPA principles and, for users in the EEA/UK, GDPR-like rights of access, rectification, and erasure via Settings export/delete.
Legal.privacyP4: Payments are handled by Stripe. We store payment session references for idempotent energy credit, not full card numbers.
Legal.privacyP5: We do not sell your personal data.
Legal.termsP1: You must meet the legal age in your region for general content
Legal.termsP2: Mature content requires confirming you are 18 or older
Legal.termsP3: Do not use the service for abuse, harassment, or illegal content
Legal.termsP4: By using MeeChat you agree to use the service lawfully, respect other creators, and not attempt to abuse energy rewards, payments, or moderation systems.
Legal.termsP5: MATURE-rated characters require age confirmation (18+). You are responsible for the content you publish and the roleplay you request.
Legal.termsP6: Energy packs are digital goods. Creator earnings currently accrue as in-app coins; cash payouts require KYC and become available only when payout status is READY.
Legal.cookiesP1: Essential cookies keep you signed in
Legal.cookiesP2: Analytics cookies run only if you consent
Legal.cookiesP3: Necessary cookies keep you signed in (Supabase session) and remember your interface language (NEXT_LOCALE).
Legal.cookiesP4: If you accept analytics, Vercel Analytics may collect anonymized usage metrics to improve the product.
